name: camayoc_provider_burn_window
description: verification-and-liveness Q20: consumption per provider over a half-open window [from, to) — the numerator of a burn rate, whose denominator is the window the caller chose. Answerable without ever knowing the ceiling: rate needs consumption alone, which is why this survives a provider that publishes no quota.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?provider (SUM(?tokens) AS ?totalTokens) WHERE { ?record a aegis:UsageRecord ; aegis:provider ?provider ; aegis:observedAt ?at ; aegis:tokensConsumed ?tokens . FILTER(?at >= "{from}" && ?at < "{to}") } GROUP BY ?provider ORDER BY ?provider

params.name: from
params.description: from parameter for this stored query.

params.name: to
params.description: to parameter for this stored query.
